Schedule with 'Lãi suất áp dụng: 23%': https://www.vib.com.vn/vn/vay-tieu-dung/chi-tiet-khoan-vay?vay=300000000&kyhan=60&nhanluong=12&luong=1&theTd=0

maxPercent.note: Highest value the calculator showed for this package ('Lãi suất: 24%', amounts up to 250M). VIB nowhere states 24% as a maximum or cap: it is the calculator's reference rate. Schedule page with 'Lãi suất áp dụng: 24%': https://www.vib.com.vn/vn/vay-tieu-dung/chi-tiet-khoan-vay?vay=30000000&kyhan=12&nhanluong=12&luong=0&theTd=1

basis.note: Not stated in words. Worked out from VIB's own repayment schedule: 30,000,000 at 24%, 12 months. Month 1 interest = 600,000 = 30,000,000 x 24% / 12; month 2 interest = 555,264 = 27,763,212 x 2%; remaining balance falls each month; total instalment is equal (2,836,788) every month; last month interest 55,623 = 2,781,165 x 2%. That is interest on the outstanding balance (reducing, annuity). Schedule assumes a 30-day month.

period.note: The calculator and schedule print 'Lãi suất: 24%' / 'Lãi suất áp dụng: 24%' with no period. Worked out: monthly interest = balance x 24% / 12, so it is a nominal yearly rate. The headline '1.9%/tháng' is 23% / 12 = 1.9167% rounded.

minPercent.note: Page: 'Từ 1.9%/tháng' and 'Lãi suất chỉ từ 1.9%/tháng'. Re-read 2026-11-03. Equals the calculator's 23%/year divided by 12 (1.9167%), rounded down for display.

maxPercent.note: No upper rate in the headline figure; the calculator's 24% is stored in the offered_range entry.

basis.note: Same page's calculator and schedule use interest on the outstanding balance; the headline text itself does not say.

amortization.note: Not stated in words. VIB's own schedule shows an equal total instalment each month (principal + interest) on a falling balance. Could arguably be treated as stated; kept as inferred because the page never names the method.

mandatory.note: Arises only if the borrower settles early.

tiers.note: Page: 'Năm 01: 4%, Năm 02: 3%, Năm 03 trở đi: 2%'. The page does not say what the percent is applied to (prepaid amount or outstanding principal), nor how partial prepayment is treated, so base is unknown.

textVi.note: Not published on the consumer loan product page, the two fee pages, or the FAQ. Searched 2026-11-03: the VIB guide article https://www.vib.com.vn/vn/cam-nang/vay/vay-the-chap/cach-tinh-no-qua-han (dated 2025-06-17) is generic (penalty rate 'thường cao hơn lãi suất thông thường từ 50% đến 150%', and elsewhere '150-200%'), so it is not this product's term. The 150% of the in-term rate that appears on VIB's mortgage, car and secured overdraft fee pages is for those secured products and is not applied here. No loan contract or general credit terms for the unsecured loan were found on vib.com.vn.

representativeExamples.note: The product page's own text example says '300 triệu, 60 tháng, 1.9%/tháng, 8.457.141 VNĐ'. Run through the calculator it shows 'Lãi suất: 23%' and the schedule shows month 1: interest 5,750,000 (= 300,000,000 x 23% / 12), principal 2,707,141, total 8,457,141. A plain annuity at 23%/12 = 1.916667%/month gives exactly 8,457,141, so the example is consistent once 1.9% is read as the rounded 23%/12. (At a literal 1.9%/month an annuity would give 8,422,705.) Basis and period are our reading of VIB's schedule, not words on the page.

Calculator output for 30,000,000 over 12 months, package 'Nhận lương qua VIB': 'Lãi suất: 24%', 'Tiền trả hàng tháng: 2.836.788 VNĐ'. The schedule page lists 12 equal instalments of 2,836,788 (total 34,041,456 = 12 x 2,836,788, our sum). Matches an annuity at 2%/month exactly. Excludes any fee or insurance (none published).

values.value: 24%/year (2.0%/month), amounts up to ~250M, package 'nhận lương qua VIB'; 23%/year above ~299M. Interest on the reducing balance (our reading of the schedule).

VIB's own vay-nhanh page that search engines index for this offer (vib.com.vn/vn/vay-nhanh/) returned a 404 page on 2026-11-03, so VIB's side of this offer could not be read. Possibly a different campaign product; not stored.

values.value: 'từ 1.1%/tháng' (MAX app cash loan, up to 1 tỷ); 'từ 0.92%/tháng' (App Store listing)
values.note: Tier 2: VIB guide article dated 2026-03-03 (says 'lãi suất thực tế có thể thay đổi') and the VIB MAX app page https://www.vib.com.vn/i/max-app; App Store listing https://apps.apple.com/vn/app/max-by-vib/id6474231257. No basis, term or conditions given; the App Store text is next to the Super Cash limit, a different product. Lower than the calculator, never stored over a Tier 1 figure.

conflicts.resolution: Stored the Tier 1 calculator figures (23% and 24%/year). The lower Tier 2 figures are marketing 'from' rates and are not used. The higher 2.5%/month (30%/year) figure from a partner campaign is Tier 3 and a 36-month 30M loan; it is NOT stored but shows the real rate for a given borrower could be higher than the calculator's. Calculator rates are VIB reference figures, not a guaranteed offer.

products.notes: Rates: VIB's calculator applies 24%/year up to roughly 250M and 23%/year from about 299M (not by term); reducing balance, equal instalments (our reading of VIB's repayment schedule). VIB never prints 'dư nợ giảm dần' for this product and never states a maximum rate; the headline 'từ 1.9%/tháng' is 23%/12 rounded. The rate shown is a reference figure and VIB says it can change. Insurance: no mention on the product page, two fee pages, FAQ, VIB guide articles or app listing. Late payment: no consumer-loan-specific term found (VIB's guide article on overdue interest, dated 2025-06-17, is generic: it quotes a 50% to 150% range and uses 150% only in an example). Absence is not proof there is none. Minimum amount: the calculator slider starts at 30,000,000 but VIB does not state it as a product minimum.
products.excludeReason: VIB publishes a 'từ X%/tháng' floor and a calculator with reference rates, but no maximum rate. Calculator rates are not a stated range, and a retailer article suggests real rates can be higher, so ranking on them could make this loan look cheaper than it is.

researchNotes: Deep dive 2026-11-03. 1) Licence: 'vib' is on data/licensed-institutions.json (legal name matches). 2) KEY FINDING: VIB's own calculator and repayment schedule (vib.com.vn/vn/vay-tieu-dung and its 'Xem chi tiết' page chi-tiet-khoan-vay) use real rates and a reducing-balance annuity. Package 'nhận lương qua VIB': 24%/year up to about 250M, 23%/year from about 299M (the headline 'từ 1.9%/tháng' is 23%/12 rounded). Package 'lương chuyển khoản / thẻ tín dụng': 25%/year up to at least 100M, 24%/year from 300M (headline 'từ 2.0%/tháng' = 24%/12). The rate depends on loan amount, not term (tested 12 to 60 months). Every calculator payment recomputed (8 samples across both packages) matches an annuity at rate/12 to the dong, and the schedule's month-1 interest equals balance x rate / 12 (30-day month). This resolves the oddity in the page example (300M, 60 months, 8,457,141): it is 23%/12 = 1.9167%/month, not 1.9%. 3) Wording caveat: VIB never writes 'dư nợ giảm dần' for this product and never states a maximum rate; the calculator is described as 'for reference, depends on lending policy at the time' and the schedule says the rate 'có thể thay đổi'. So basis and period are provenance inferred, and the 23% to 25% range is a reference range, not a guarantee. Because the three offered-range conditions are met (VIB's own product page gives a rate per amount tier, basis and period are worked out from VIB's own schedule, no newer official source contradicts it) the two unsecured loan packages are set to excludeFromRanking false; this is a judgement call and can be reverted by setting it back to true. 4) Contradicting figures, none stored: 'từ 1.1%/tháng' (VIB guide article 2026-03-03 and MAX app page), 'từ 0.92%/tháng' (App Store listing, next to Super Cash), and 'từ 2,5%/tháng dư nợ giảm dần' for 30M/36 months in a retailer (Di Động Việt, 2026-04-02) article for an April to December 2026 campaign. VIB's own vay-nhanh page, which search engines index for the 2.5% offer, returned 404 on 2026-11-03. The 2.5% case suggests an individual borrower's rate can be higher than the calculator's. 5) '17%/year' lead: not found. topi.vn/lai-suat-ngan-hang-vib.html (dated 2026-11-02) lists no VIB unsecured rate (its only consumer figure is secured, 8.8%). VIB's own guide table (vib.com.vn/vn/cam-nang/vay/vay-bat-dong-san/lai-suat-vay-cac-ngan-hang, dated 2024-12-06) lists VIB unsecured as 'Từ 14' %/year and shows '17' only for other banks (Agribank 7.0-17, SHB 8.5-17). No official source supports 17%/year; do not use it. 6) Insurance: nothing on any unsecured-loan page; the only VIB insurance premium found (1.5% x 120% of loan) belongs to the secured car loan.
